candidates.snippet: Zelensky says Trump has given final approval for Ukraine to receive licenses to produce Patriot missiles. He says Trump told him during their last meeting.

Dnipro Osint says Ukraine’s Defense Forces hit the Iskra electronics plant in Ulyanovsk, with over ten impacts recorded on its grounds. It says the plant’s products are used in Kh-59M2/M2A missiles and Pantsir-S1 systems, and the factory claims a nearly full production cycle. htt
